text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing, Seeking 
the Pearl suddenly stopped in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Fwoooooooosh, BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...!! Is that... bottle rockets!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! Were you just launching bottle 
rockets!?

Hm? Ah... that's right. Those are 
fireworks I made myself. I was just 
test-firing them.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Which means you're a pyrotechnician?! 
That's incredible, show me more!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The elderly man we met said he's a 
pyrotechnician with a workshop nearby. 
Apparently, he regularly hosts 
firework-making workshops for children."

text_block_list.name: Pyrotechnician
text_block_list.text:
"I'm holding another workshop soon, so 
I've been prototyping all sorts of 
fireworks to show the kids there."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A hands-on workshop... How exciting! Do 
you have other prototypes besides this 
one?

text_block_list.name: Pyrotechnician
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there are plenty. ...Would you care to 
try making some too, if you'd like?

text_block_list.name: Pyrotechnician
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly, secure it tightly to the 
bamboo stick. That will control the 
rocket's thrust.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's why it flies straight...! 
I'm gonna try launching one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*whistle~*, *BANG!*)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wah... Did it work!? Was it a success!?

text_block_list.name: Pyrotechnician
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's pretty good for your first 
time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl looks like she's having 
a blast. Seeing her act so innocently is 
rare and truly heartwarming.

text_block_list.name: Pyrotechnician
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, right. Hey you, got any bright ideas 
for me?

text_block_list.name: Pyrotechnician
text_block_list.text:
I want to make bottle rockets that kids 
will enjoy even more, but honestly, I'm in 
a bit of a rut. I'd love to hear a young 
person's opinion—got any ideas?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about making dance music 
with whistle-tone rockets!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Drawing pictures with sparklers sounds fun 
too, don't you think? Like, for example, a 
star!

text_block_list.name: Pyrotechnician
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, well that's fascinating! That 
said, making actual music is pretty tricky 
mechanically... Though if we get creative, 
we might manage something close...

text_block_list.name: Pyrotechnician
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, let's try making it. I can at 
least tap out a rhythm with sound, and 
drawing simple shapes like stars shouldn't 
be too hard."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Will we be drawing with sparks?! 
And we'll be using flame tests for the 
coloring, right!

text_block_list.name: Pyrotechnician
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly, you can make any color you 
want with these color agents. One firework 
won't be enough, so we'll have to make 
lots of fountain fireworks alongside it, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'll make them! Lots of them!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, done! Our third fountain 
firework!"
choice_data_list:
Making good progress! What color was the 
one you were just making?

Making good progress! What color was the 
one you were just making?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That one just now was yellow! I made red 
and orange too... so what color should I 
make next?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Good sense, Trainer! Let's make a star 
with warm, fiery gradients!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~ Producing sounds at a steady rhythm 
really is difficult after all.

text_block_list.name: Pyrotechnician
text_block_list.text:
Still, you're on the right track. Just 
adjust the length of the fuse a bit 
more...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I... Is it done, I wonder...!? 'A burst of 
fireworks that beats a dancing rhythm and 
paints the stars' rings'!!

text_block_list.name: Pyrotechnician
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's try hitting right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wheeeew, clatter-clatter-clap-clap!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—A... mazing! This dancing rhythm! The 
star-like fireworks lighting up the 
sky!!!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Amazing! A huge success!!

text_block_list.name: Pyrotechnician
text_block_list.text:
Hahahahaha! Now that's incredible! I've 
never seen anything like this before!!
choice_data_list: You really love bottle rockets, don't you?
You really love bottle rockets, huh?

text_block_list.name: Pyrotechnician
text_block_list.text:
Hahahahaha! Now that's incredible! I've 
never seen anything like this before!!
choice_data_list: You really love bottle rockets, don't you?
You really love bottle rockets, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What?! Truly, the potential of bottle 
rockets is expanding this much?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I want to make so many more different 
things! Come on, what do you say!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl seems completely 
engrossed in making fireworks. It's quite 
rare to see her pleading like this.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's come back for another trial 
workshop.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu, and you'll be with me then, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Making fireworks was exciting, of course, 
but... the reason today was so fun and 
captivating was because I was with you!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. Launching bottle rockets is so 
active, positive, and exciting, don't you 
think?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It feels like they're cheering me on and 
hyping up my determination to pursue every 
possibility.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's why I love it so much.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this scenery, this rhythm... I could 
watch and listen to it forever...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl looked so happy as she 
murmured that. Seeing her joy brought a 
warm feeling to my chest, glad that I 
could give her such a wonderful 
experience.
